description: Estimates how busy the surroundings of a point are by hour of a day of the week (index against the place's weekly average, level 1-5, people rounded to tens), the peak hours, and the busiest spots nearby. Always an estimate.

at.description: Moment to evaluate, ISO 8601. Without an offset it is the local time of the place. Default: now.

city.description: City name within a covered area; used when lat/lon are not given (the part of the city with most venues is used as the centre).

day.description: Day of the week. Default: the day of `at` (today).

hour.description: Hour of the day (local). Default: the hour of `at` (now); with `day` alone the whole day is returned.

radius_m.description: Radius for the busiest spots nearby. Default 1500.

name: rhythm
title: When a place is busiest
